title: Office Order No.A.1329/2024 dated 18/08/2026, regarding assignment of the charge of the post of Registrar (Vigilance), High Court of Gujarat.
text:
KEY LINES:

OFFICE ORDER
No,A.1329/2024
The Honourable Chief Justice, High Court of Gujarat, Ahmedabad has been
pleased to assign Mr. Hemang R. Rawal, Registrar General, High Court of Gujarat,
Ahmedabad, the additional charge of the post of Registrar (Vigilance), High Court
of Gujarat, Ahmedabad over and above his duties, with immediate effect.
By order of the Honourable Chief
Justice of the High Court of Gujarat.
High Court of Gujarat at Sola,
Ahmedabad - 380 060. OW
(Hemang R. Rawal)
